verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents continuous queries, which are SQL statements that run continuously to analyze incoming data in real time. Dataform, its in-platform ELT service, lets you develop, test, version and schedule transformation workflows with dependency trees, and release notes add Git-managed pipelines. Together these cover both the continuous and the scheduled/declarative transformation paths. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of incremental-table processing and continuous-query output/sink details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
